SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
Section 1, Special Branch
REPORT
File No. ......
Date March 29, 19 38

Subject Communication dated 21-3-38 from the Netherlands Consulate-
General concerning Mr. S. Ulianoff.
Made by D.S.I. Prokofiev Forwarded by C. Crawford. D. I.

Sergey Mihailovich ULIANOFF, 49, Russian, is reported
to have arrived in Shanghai from Harbin in December, 1935 and has
since been residing in this city. At present he is connected
with the Russian Opera Company as a stage manager. His last known
address is 86 Route Paul Henry ( Tel. 71454 ).

It is reported that until about one year ago he coha-
bited with one Klavdia Trofimovna SITNIKOFF, Russian, and that
they lived together for four or five years. Soon after their ar-
rival here Mrs. Sitnikoff left him and is now living with a musi-
cian named Rott at 347/5 Avenue du Roi Albert ( King Albert Apts. )

Attached herewith is a copy of the application form
which Ulianoff filled in when registering with the Russian Emi-
grants' Committee, 118/1 Moulmein Road, on January 9, 1935. Of the
two children mentioned in this application the girl is reported
to be with Mrs Sitnikoff at present, while no information is so far
available regarding the whereabouts of the boy. It is also re-
ported that Ulianoff is not their father.

A. Prokofiev
D.S.I.

D. C. ( Special Branch )

（左侧手写批注：）
D.B.R.
29/3.

报告
档案号 ......
日期 1938年3月29日

事由：荷兰总领事馆1938年3月21日来函，涉及 S. 乌里扬诺夫先生。
由侦探副督察普罗科菲耶夫（D.S.I. Prokofiev）撰写，由侦探督察克劳福德（C. Crawford. D. I.）转呈。

谢尔盖·米哈伊洛维奇·乌里扬诺夫（Sergey Mihailovich ULIANOFF），49岁，俄国人，据报于1935年12月从哈尔滨抵达上海，此后一直居住在本市。目前他受雇于俄罗斯歌剧团，担任舞台监督。其最后已知地址为亨利路（Route Paul Henry）86号（电话 71454）。

据报，直到大约一年前，他与一名俄国女子克拉夫季娅·特罗菲莫夫娜·西特尼科娃（Klavdia Trofimovna SITNIKOFF）同居，两人共同生活了四五年。他们抵达此处后不久，西特尼科娃夫人便离开了他，现与一名名叫罗特（Rott）的音乐家居住在阿尔伯特王路（Avenue du Roi Albert）347/5号（阿尔伯特王公寓）。

随函附上乌里扬诺夫于1935年1月9日在莫尔缅路（Moulmein Road）118/1号俄罗斯移民委员会登记时填写的申请表副本。该申请书中提到的两个孩子中，据报女孩目前与西特尼科娃夫人在一起，而关于男孩的下落迄今尚无信息。另据报，乌里扬诺夫并非这两个孩子的生父。

A. 普罗科菲耶夫
侦探副督察

特科副督察长

（左侧手写批注：）
D.B.R.
3月29日。

CONSULAAT-GENERAAL DER NEDERLANDEN
VOOR MIDDEN-CHINA.
TEL. AD. HOLLANDIA.

No.824.                                        SHANGHAI,      21st March 1938.
                                                                    REG.STN
                                                                    B. D. 8426

Sir,

    I have the honour to inform you that Mrs.J.P.
Hakkenbroek of Netherlands nationality, contracted a
marriage with Serge Uljanoff at Bandoeng on November
4, 1921.

    Soon after the marriage Uljanoff left her.

    According to rumours Uljanoff contracted another
marriage afterwards, which has been dissolved in the
meantime.

    As Mrs. Hakkenbroek, who is residing in Holland,
wishes to regain her Netherlands nationality, she intends
to start divorce proceedings. For this purpose I should
like to get in touch with Serge Uljanoff, who is said to
be connected with the Russian Opera at Shanghai.

    I should be greatly obliged to you if you would let
me know whether anything is known about the second marriage
of Uljanoff and whether he resides at Shanghai at the mo-
ment.

                                                I have the honour to be,
                                                        Sir,
S1                                          Your obedient servant,
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE / m.b. / 22 MAR. 1938 / SPECIAL BRANCH）
                                                Consul-General.

The Deputy Commissioner,
    Special Branch,Shanghai Municipal Police,
            SHANGHAI.

D. S. J. Prokofiev              D.S.P 22/3
S. 62/3.

荷兰驻华中总领事馆
电话地址：HOLLANDIA

第824号。                                        上海，1938年3月21日。
                                                                    登记站
                                                                    B. D. 8426

先生：

    谨此告知，荷兰籍女士 J.P. 哈肯布鲁克（J.P. Hakkenbroek）于1921年11月4日在万隆（Bandoeng）与谢尔盖·乌里扬诺夫（Serge Uljanoff）结婚。

    婚后不久，乌里扬诺夫便离她而去。

    据传闻，乌里扬诺夫此后又缔结了一次婚姻，但该婚姻目前已解除。

    鉴于居住在荷兰的哈肯布鲁克夫人希望恢复其荷兰国籍，她打算启动离婚程序。为此，我希望与据说在上海俄罗斯歌剧团工作的谢尔盖·乌里扬诺夫取得联系。

    若阁下能告知是否知晓乌里扬诺夫的第二次婚姻情况，以及他目前是否居住在上海，我将不胜感激。

                                                谨致
                                                        敬礼，
S1                                          您顺从的仆人，
（印章：上海公共租界工部局 / m.b. / 1938年3月22日 / 特科）
                                                总领事。

上海公共租界工部局警务处
特科副督察长
            上海。

D. S. J. 普罗科菲耶夫              D.S.P 3月22日
S. 62/3.
